title: Google-style maintenance automation deschedules network control plane
scenario: automation deschedules control-plane jobs, fail-static expires, BGP/TE state degrades and service probes fail while workloads stay alive
fault_evidence: external route to frontend prefix withdrawn
current_runtime_status: S1.5 live accepted at 194 containers with case-local maintenance automation, cluster managers, network-control-plane replicas, config store, route distributor, TE controller, 8 region frontends, 6 workloads, real BGP peer disable/enable for external route withdrawal/restoration, constrained recovery, and region verification; congestion is represented by control/TE state and reachability, not full packet-level TE
